hero.subtitle: Indonesian Coffee Roastery
hero.description: Small batch roasting with carefully selected beans from Indonesia's finest coffee-growing regions.

about.label: About Us
about.p1: At Gumawang Coffee, we believe every coffee bean has a story.
about.p2: We source premium beans directly from Indonesian farmers and roast them carefully in small batches to preserve each origin's unique character.
about.p3: Whether you're a cafe owner, reseller, or coffee enthusiast, we're committed to delivering exceptional quality in every cup.

products.label: Our Coffee
products.description: Discover our carefully curated selection, each with its own unique character and story.

gayo.name: Arabica Gayo
gayo.description: Smooth and well-balanced with a hint of citrus brightness. Grown in the highlands of Aceh at 1,200-1,600m elevation.

preanger.name: Java Preanger
preanger.description: Delicate and aromatic with a sweet, honey-like finish. Grown in the volcanic soils of West Java's Priangan highlands.

toraja.name: Toraja
toraja.description: Full-bodied and bold with a complex spicy character. Grown in the highlands of Sulawesi at 1,500-1,800m elevation.

process.label: The Process
process.title: From Farm to Bag
process.description: Every step is crafted with care and precision.

s1.title: Bean Selection
s1.desc: Hand-selecting the finest beans from trusted Indonesian farmers.

s2.title: Quality Inspection
s2.desc: Rigorous screening for size, color, and defect-free beans.

s3.title: Small Batch Roasting
s3.desc: Artisan roasting in small batches to preserve unique flavor profiles.

s4.title: Fresh Packaging
s4.desc: Immediately sealed with one-way valves to maintain peak freshness.

r1.desc: Every batch is roasted to order, ensuring peak freshness and flavor in every bean.

r2.title: Premium Beans

r3.title: Quality Control
r3.desc: Rigorous quality checks at every stage — from sourcing to packaging.

r4.title: Wholesale Ready
r4.desc: Flexible wholesale options for cafes, restaurants, and retail partners.
